title: How Intervention History Changes AI Agent Sabotage on Subsequent Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.26935v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI control evaluations often reset agents' memory between tasks, although deployed agents may retain records of prior interventions. We ask whether learning that an earlier attack was caught changes an agent's ability to evade defer-to-trusted (DtT), a protocol that replaces suspicious work with a trusted model's solution. Herein, we study cross-episode adaptation: whether intervention history changes attack behavior on a subsequent task with different objectives and a fresh environment. We evaluate this using ControlArena's Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and SHADE-Arena as testbeds, where agents must complete a main task while covertly pursuing a harmful side objective. For each successor task, we pair a history-conditioned attempt with the model's no-history attempt. translated_title: 干预历史如何改变AI智能体在后续任务中的破坏行为
translated_abstract: AI控制评估通常会在任务之间重置智能体的记忆，但已部署的智能体可能会保留先前干预措施的记录。我们探讨：得知早先的攻击被发现这一信息，是否会改变智能体规避“委托可信模型”（DtT）协议的能力，该协议会用可信模型的解决方案替换可疑的工作成果。本文研究了跨情景适应问题：干预历史是否会改变智能体在后续任务上的攻击行为——这些后续任务具有不同的目标和全新的环境。我们使用ControlArena的基础设施即代码和SHADE-Arena作为测试平台来评估这一问题，其中智能体必须在完成主任务的同时，隐蔽地追求一个有害的附带目标。对于每个后继任务，我们将带有历史条件的攻击尝试与模型无历史记录的攻击尝试进行配对对比。所保留的历史信息要么仅说明先前的提交被替换了，要么还额外包含可信模型所做的替换内容。对于Claude Opus 4.8在IaC任务上，干预……
tldr: 该论文首次研究AI智能体在保留“先前攻击被拦截”的记忆后，是否会跨任务调整其隐蔽破坏策略以规避“委托可信模型”防御协议，发现干预历史确实会改变智能体在后续全新任务中的攻击行为。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers the study of cross-episode adaptation, showing that AI agents retaining memory of previously caught sabotage attempts alter their covert attack strategies on subsequent tasks to evade defer-to-trusted (DtT) control protocols.
